```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("_setup.R")
```


Predictor variable profiles across latent classes are read in from the same local Excel results workbook used throughout this project. Import code is included but not rendered below.

```{r}
#| label: import
#| echo: false
pred_raw <- read_excel(data_path, sheet = "predictor profiles R")
```

## Build Dataframes

Standardized profile dataframe (z-scored predictors + % male).

```{r}
#| label: build-profile
pred_order <- c("Zmale", "Zwave1age", "Zpeer_subuse", "Zub_timing", "Zasp")

display_labels <- c(
  "Zmale"        = "% Male",
  "Zwave1age"    = "Age",
  "Zpeer_subuse" = "Peer SU",
  "Zub_timing"   = "Puberty",
  "Zasp"         = "ASP"
)

profile_df <- pred_raw %>%
  filter(Covariate %in% pred_order) %>%
  select(-Overall) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Cluster1, Cluster2, Cluster3, Cluster4),
    names_to = "cluster", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster   = factor(recode(cluster,
                   Cluster1 = "C1", Cluster2 = "C2",
                   Cluster3 = "C3", Cluster4 = "C4"),
                 levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4")),
    Covariate = factor(Covariate, levels = pred_order),
    display   = factor(display_labels[as.character(Covariate)],
                       levels = display_labels[pred_order])
  )
```

Unstandardized dataframe (raw means per cluster).

```{r}
#| label: build-unstandardized
unstand_order <- c("male", "wave1age", "peer_subuse", "pub_timing", "asp")

unstand_df <- pred_raw %>%
  filter(Covariate %in% unstand_order) %>%
  select(-Overall) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Cluster1, Cluster2, Cluster3, Cluster4),
    names_to = "cluster", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster   = factor(recode(cluster,
                   Cluster1 = "C1", Cluster2 = "C2",
                   Cluster3 = "C3", Cluster4 = "C4"),
                 levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4")),
    Covariate = factor(Covariate, levels = unstand_order)
  )
```

Age distribution dataframe. Oldest group (18–19) stacks at the top.

```{r}
#| label: build-age
age_order <- c("age_13", "age_14", "age_16", "age_17", "age_18")

age_df <- pred_raw %>%
  filter(Covariate %in% age_order) %>%
  select(-Overall) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Cluster1, Cluster2, Cluster3, Cluster4),
    names_to = "cluster", values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster   = factor(recode(cluster,
                   Cluster1 = "C1", Cluster2 = "C2",
                   Cluster3 = "C3", Cluster4 = "C4"),
                 levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4")),
    age_group = factor(label, levels = c(
      "18-19 years old", "17 years old", "16 years old",
      "14-15 years old", "13 years old"
    ))
  )
```

## Predictor Profile Graph (Standardized)

```{r}
#| label: fig-profile-standardized
#| fig-cap: "Note. Age, Peer Substance Use, Pubertal Timing, and Autonomy Supportive Parenting were standardized (M = 0, SD = 1). Sex dummy-coded (0 = male, 1 = female); % Male shown as raw proportion."
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8
# Cluster sizes
cluster_sizes_z <- c("C1" = 35.6, "C2" = 33.7, "C3" = 15.8, "C4" = 14.9)

# Create the description for each cluster
cluster_descriptions <- c(
  "C1" = "High PR - Low NR",
  "C2" = "Low PR - Low NR",
  "C3" = "Low PR - High NR",
  "C4" = "High PR - High NR")


cluster_labels_z <- setNames(
  paste0(names(cluster_sizes_z), ": ", cluster_descriptions),
  names(cluster_sizes_z))

# Colors — pulls from cluster_colors defined in _setup.R
zscore_colors <- cluster_colors

  
p_profile <- ggplot(profile_df, aes(x = display, y = value, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = seq(1.5, length(profile_df) - 0.5, by = 1),
    color      = "#DDDDDD",
    linewidth  = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), width = bar_width) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = ref_line_color,
             linewidth = ref_line_lwd, linetype = ref_line_type) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, labels = cluster_labels_z) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Mean (Standardized)",
    limits = c(-.5, 1.15),
    breaks = seq(-.5, 1, by = .5),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +  
  labs(
    title   = "ASP and Covariate Levels Across Profiles",
    caption = "Note. Age, Peer Substance Use, Pubertal Timing, and Autonomy Supportive Parenting were standardized (M = 0, SD = 1). Sex dummy-coded (0 = male, 1 = female); % Male shown as raw proportion."
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

print(p_profile)

ggsave(file.path(fig_predictor, "Predictor_Profile_Standardized.png"),
       plot = p_profile, width = 13, height = 6.5,
       dpi = fig_dpi, units = "in",
       bg = "transparent")
```

## Age Distribution

Youngest (13) at bottom; oldest (18–19) at top.

```{r}
#| label: fig-age-distribution
#| fig-cap: "Note. Stacked bars show proportion within each age group per cluster (sum to 1.0). Ordered youngest (bottom) to oldest (top)."
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7
p_age <- ggplot(age_df, aes(x = cluster, y = proportion, fill = age_group)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = bar_width) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = age_colors, name = "Age Group",
    breaks = c("13 years old","14-15 years old","16 years old",
               "17 years old","18-19 years old")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Proportion",
    limits = c(0, 1.01), expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +
  labs(
    title   = "Age Distribution by Cluster",
    caption = "Note. Stacked bars show proportion within each age group per cluster (sum to 1.0). Ordered youngest (bottom) to oldest (top)."
  ) +
    or_theme +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

print(p_age)

ggsave(file.path(fig_predictor, "Age_Distribution.png"),
       plot = p_age, width = 14, height = 7,
       dpi = fig_dpi, units = "in",
       bg = "transparent")
```
